p: tribes of Israel to Shechem: That is, the nine tribes and the half.
God: Before the ark which was brought to Shechem, when they went to bury Joseph's bones.
flood in old time: Euphrates in Mesopotamia, Ge 11:26.
men of Jericho fought against you: Because it was the chief city, under it he contains all the country: else they of the city fought not.
fear the LORD: This is the true use of God's benefits, to learn by it to fear and serve him with an upright conscience.
but as for me and my: This teaches us that if all the world would go from God, yet every one of us particularly is bound to cleave to him.
for he is our God: How much more are we bound to serve God in Christ, by whom we have received the redemption of our souls.
against yourselves that ye have chosen: If you do the contrary, your own mouths will condemn you.
gods which are among you: Out of your hearts and otherwise.
made a covenant with the people: By joining God and the people together: also he repeated the promises and threatenings out of the Law.
hath heard all the words of: So that man's deception should not go unpunished, the dumb creatures will cry for vengeance.
served the LORD all the days: Such are the people commonly as their rulers are.
